item.title: Ariane 6 launches two Galileo satellites
item.dc:creator: Staff reporter
item.description: Ariane 6 lifted off from Kourou on Tuesday evening and placed two Galileo satellites into orbit, the third Ariane 6 flight this year.
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Ariane 6 lifted off from Kourou on Tuesday evening and placed two Galileo satellites into orbit for the European Union's navigation system.

Arianespace confirmed separation of both spacecraft. ESA and the European Commission oversee the Galileo programme.

item.title: ESA picks Isar Aerospace for four Launcher Challenge missions
item.dc:creator: Staff reporter
item.description: ESA has chosen Isar Aerospace for 4 missions of the European Launcher Challenge, flying the Spectrum rocket from 2027.
item.content:encoded:
ESA has chosen Isar Aerospace for 4 missions of the European Launcher Challenge, flying the Spectrum rocket from 2027.

The German launch company competes with other European launch startups for institutional missions.

item.title: MaiaSpace completes first hot-fire of its upper stage engine
item.dc:creator: Staff reporter
item.description: MaiaSpace, the ArianeGroup subsidiary developing a partly reusable launcher, completed the first hot-fire test of its upper stage engine.
item.content:encoded:
MaiaSpace, the ArianeGroup subsidiary developing a partly reusable launcher, completed the first hot-fire test of its upper stage engine.

The test campaign continues ahead of a maiden flight.
